Name: Perez-uzzah
Description: The place on the road to Jerusalem where Uzzah reached out to steady the ark and died, and which David named Perez-uzzah, 'the breach of Uzzah,' because the LORD had broken out against him there.
BiblicalSignificance: Perez-uzzah is a name born of fear and reverence: the place where Israel learned again that the holy ark was not to be handled casually.
RelatedPeople: Uzzah, Son of Abinadab; King David
